ruling: docs/plans/2026-08-17-founding-workplan.md §4b (owner rulings 2026-08-18 morning, BINDING), item 2: derived datasets with an independent evaluation system are NOT leakage.

verdict_basis.classification: derived dataset with an independent evaluation system
verdict_basis.reasoning: M3-SLU is scored on its own splits by its own evaluation harness; it does not read or report against this repository's AMI role registry or the frozen AMI ASR partition. A dataset's own official evaluation system being independent of ours is what makes reuse of its (partially AMI-sourced) content a hygiene question, not a leakage question.

discovery_use: ADMITTED. No registry role or column is required to use M3-SLU for discovery; it is governed by its own splits, not by the AMI role registry.
own_metrics: M3-SLU metrics are reported on M3-SLU's own splits only, using M3-SLU's own evaluation harness -- never blended with, or substituted for, this repository's AMI-role-registry-gated metrics.

content_overlap_hygiene_note.field_join: Impossible from shipped fields. The text layer carries exactly eight keys (id, instruction, question, answer, script, n_speakers, data_source, _shard) across all 10,808 sampled instances; the parquet layer adds only 'audio' (struct<bytes, path>), and 'path' is a restatement of the corpus-tagged sequence id (e.g. ami_task2_1719.wav). There is no meeting id, no session field, no timing, and no mapping from M3-SLU's <spk1>/<spk2> tags to AMI's participant letters.
content_overlap_hygiene_note.content_join: Feasible and demonstrated: the 'script' field is verbatim AMI dialogue. A normalised 12-token n-gram match from each instance's longest turns against an index of 166 AMI transcripts resolved 10 of 12 probe instances to exactly one meeting each -- the signature of a real join, not noise.
content_overlap_hygiene_note.verbatim_ngram_join_demonstrated_into_am: One probe instance, ami_task2_1869, resolves via the content join to ES2011a -- a member of this repository's frozen dev-18 (asr-eval role). M3-SLU's AMI material therefore draws from meetings this repository actively exposes for other purposes, and there is no shipped field that tells you which without running the content join.
content_overlap_hygiene_note.consequence: If M3-SLU instances are ever resolved to specific AMI meetings and used alongside this repository's own AMI-derived material in the same analysis, that resolution must be run first and the result filtered through the AMI role registry's normal exposure rules for the resolved meeting (docs/readiness/2026-08-18-ami-role-registry.md); M3-SLU must not be treated as meeting-anonymous by default in that situation. This does not bar M3-SLU's own standalone discovery or evaluation use, which needs no such resolution.
